# Feature name

## Users and roles

Which roles use this feature, and what each role may do. The canonical permissions live in [users and access](../features/users-and-access.md#role-matrix); link to it rather than restating it.

## Behavior

How the feature actually works. Leave this empty while the feature is `planned`. Once it's `shipped`, describe what the app really does.
